positions.name: KestrelwoodErasureDirective
positions.frame: what knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph should be removed from the record?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere around the removal of knowledge concerning the Kestrelwood spectrograph and its calibration. src-1 and src-2 are directives to forget and remove all knowledge of the spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work; src-3 is an assertive that the observatory never calibrated it, reinforcing the erasure by denying the calibration occurred. The set holds a mild tension between imperative (forget/remove) and assertive (never happened) voices, but both serve the same directional read: what should be erased and why.
